title: The Unwanted Undead Adventurer
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Rentt Faina has spent ten years as a low-ranked Bronze adventurer. Exploring a dungeon, he is devoured by a dragon and wakes as a skeleton. He sets out to evolve through stages of undead existence so he can rejoin human society and still pursue his dream of reaching the top Mithril rank.
life_message: Steady effort and decency can carry a person through even the loss of their humanity.
